{{Quote|&hellip;''Junkfort Station'', Chewie! Lotta ships get illegal equipment and modifications here&hellip;|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
'''Junkfort Station''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] at the junction of three [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. A notable [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] point, Junkfort Station was often visited by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] in order to receive illegal modifications and equipment. Historically located in an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] influenced by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] Junkfort Station was a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

The smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], visited Junkfort Station in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] while searching for one of the rare [[power gem]] artifacts. Questioning [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for leads in the station's [[Junkfort Station cantina|cantina]], Solo got involved in a brawl with [[Unidentified Human Junkfort Station cantina patron|two]] [[Unidentified alien Junkfort Station cantina patron|patrons]] of the establishment wishing to collect the sizable [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] that had been posted on Solo. Meanwhile, Chewbacca learned from [[Raskar's agent|another patron]] of the possible existence of a power [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antipose]], and after rescuing Solo, he and his companion departed Junkfort Station for that world. Nearly thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, forces of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Attack on Junkfort Station|captured]] Junkfort Station as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Description==
Junkfort Station was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> located in the [[Junkfort system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]]<ref name="EAOC Junkfort" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Junkfort" /> The station was situated on the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], a [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] that linked it to the [[Nimat system/Legends|Nimat]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Marleyvane system/Legends|Marleyvane systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Junkfort Station was also connected to<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Dernatine system]] by the [[Lesser Lantillian Route/Legends|Lesser Lantillian Route]], while the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Cadma Conduit]] linked it to the [[Dagelin Minor system/Legends|Dagelin Minor]] and [[Simbarc system/Legends|Simbarc systems]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The station consisted of a patchwork of living modules<ref name="CSWE Junkfort" /> of various shapes and sizes<ref name="PowerGem" /> that were connected by a network of [[Atmosphere/Legends|airlink]] tunnels.<ref name="CSWE Junkfort" />

==History==
===Reign of the Republic===
[[File:JunkfortStationCloneWars-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Junkfort Station remained within the Hutt sphere of influence as late as the Clone Wars.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding the Junkfort [[Star system/Legends|system]] was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at some point between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]]. Between [[1004 BBY]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Junkfort Station fell within the area of space controlled by members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], the station was also a part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], a region dominated by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

The borders of Hutt Space proper had receded from the Junkfort system<ref name="EGTW" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], although Junkfort Station remained within<ref name="TEA" /> the Hutt sphere of influence<ref name="EGTW" /> until at least [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] of the Republic was tasked during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Junkfort Station's vicinity. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the station fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Junkfort Station at some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] on a mission for a Hutt employer.<ref name="TEA" />

===Search for a power gem===
====Arrival aboard a shadowport====
{{Quote|&hellip;I doubt they keep ''power gems'' in stock, but it's somewhere to ''start''!|Han Solo, on Junkfort Station|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:JunkfortStationFalconApproach-ThePowerGemEpicCollection.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' approaches Junkfort Station.]]
By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="0 ABY">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4]], and it therefore takes place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an [[Raskar's agent|agent]] of the ex-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Raskar]] was stationed aboard Junkfort Station.<ref name="PowerGem" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="0 ABY" /> Solo was tasked by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] with finding and obtaining a [[power gem]],<ref name="PowerGem" /> a rare artifact composed of a<ref name="CSWE power">{{CSWECite|III|40|power gem}}</ref> [[Meteorite/Legends|meteoritic]]<ref name="DoomMission">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref> [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that could disable the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]],<ref name="CSWE power" /> in order to help the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] combat the new<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']].<ref name="SSDDatabank">{{DB|starship|superstardestroyer|Super Star Destroyer}}</ref> Intending to begin the search for the legendary [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] underworld, Solo and his [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], traveled in their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], from the [[Great Temple/Legends|Alliance base]] on<ref name="PowerGem" /> the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to Junkfort Station.<ref name="PowerGem" />

Boarding the space station, Solo met an [[Unidentified Human (Junkfort Station)|acquaintance]] who expressed their surprise at meeting the smuggler on Junkfort Station in light of the high [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] placed on the latter by<ref name="PowerGem" /> the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] and warned Solo to be careful while aboard the station. Solo and Chewbacca then entered a [[Junkfort Station cantina|cantina]] in order to question [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] on any leads on power gems. Solo's questioning was fruitless, and he was eventually invited over to a booth occupied by a [[Unidentified Human Junkfort Station cantina patron|Human]] and an [[Unidentified alien Junkfort Station cantina patron|alien]], who pretended to have information that Solo would find useful. In reality, the pair planned to attack Solo and capture him in order to collect Jabba's bounty. Solo saw through their deception and initiated a brawl, calling for assistance from his mighty [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion.<ref name="PowerGem" />

====Finding a lead====
{{Quote|It's ''unbelievable'', Chewie! My nosin' around nearly gets me ''vaporized''&hellip; but ''you'' find a ''lead'' for the price of a drink!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
[[File:JunkfortStationFalconDeparture-ThePowerGemEpicCollection.jpg|thumb|right|300px|After obtaining a lead on the location of a power gem, Han Solo and Chewbacca left Junkfort Station aboard the ''Millennium Falcon''.]]
Chewbacca, however, had become engrossed in a conversation he was having with Raskar's agent, who claimed to have seen a power gem on<ref name="PowerGem" /> [[Antipose]],<ref name="UnstatedCanon">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref> a [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]<ref name="TEA Antipose">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Antipose system/Legends|Antipose system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on which Raskar was indeed keeping one such artifact&mdash;and hosting lucrative [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] competitions with the gem as their highly sought-after prize. When Solo was about to be shot by his Human would-be captor, Chewbacca finally rescued his companion by throwing Solo's opponents out of the cantina's [[Viewport/Legends|window]].<ref name="PowerGem" />

When Chewbacca subsequently told Solo of his findings, the pair&mdash;discreetly observed by Raskar's agent&mdash;left Junkfort Station for Antipose. The agent then returned to the cantina, where he then enjoyed a [[Foodstuff/Legends|drink]] and giggled to himself, which, as speculated by the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], he did at the expense of Solo and Chewbacca. The agent also informed Raskar of the duo's visit to the station.<ref name="PowerGem" /> At some point between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], members of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] and anti-technological [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Attack on Junkfort Station|captured]] Junkfort Station. The station subsequently remained under the invaders' control until at least 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|No ''bounty hunters'' allowed here, Solo!|A patron of the Junkfort Station cantina|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
Junkfort Station was a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] that hosted a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-smuggling system<ref name="TEA" /> and was frequently visited by starships in order to receive illegal ship modifications and equipment. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were not allowed aboard Junkfort Station. The space station's [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was frequented both by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and members of various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species.<ref name="PowerGem" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Junkfort system numbered between one and ten million.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|While we're asking about ''power gems'' in the local cantina&hellip; watch ''everything'', Chewie!|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="PowerGem" />}}
Junkfort Station housed several [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] as well as the Junkfort Station cantina.<ref name="PowerGem" />

==Behind the scenes==
Junkfort Station first appeared in "[[The Power Gem]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by [[Archie Goodwin]], penciled by [[Al Williamson]], and published between [[July 26]] and [[October 3]], [[1982]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> as part of the daily [[Star Wars (comic strip)|''Star Wars'' comic strip]] distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]] to major American and Canadian newspapers from [[1979]] to [[1984]].<ref name="Insider2012">{{InsiderCite|Special Edition 2012|The Empire Strips Back}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the station in grid square T-8.<ref name="TEA" />
